stage_1_ingestion.raw_report_text: A 5-gallon container of degreasing solvent was being transferred at the parts-cleaning station when the hose connector failed, spilling an estimated 2-3 gallons onto the floor. The spill reached a nearby floor drain before the area could be contained. Two employees in the area evacuated per procedure; no injuries or skin contact reported. Spill kit was used to contain the remainder. EHS was notified. Occurred on day shift.

factors.evidence: Spill reaching the drain before containment suggests either no secondary containment (berm/drain cover) was in place, or containment response time exceeded the spill spread rate.

factors.evidence: Connector failures can stem from wear/inspection gaps; plausible but not evidenced in this report.
factors.description: Possible inadequate inspection/replacement interval for transfer hose connectors (unconfirmed).
